name: RoboDR - Sensor blind or tampered
description: The robot's sensor cannot see (input silent or ended, queue overflow, evidence truncated, discovery not inspected). Treat its silence as unknown, not safe. Observe-only: alerts, never responds.
query: event.module : "robodr" and (rule.id : "robot.agent.input_silent" or rule.id : "robot.agent.input_ended" or rule.id : "robot.agent.queue_overflow" or rule.id : "robot.agent.evidence_truncated" or rule.id : "robot.rtps.discovery_not_inspected")
author: Singularity RD
